title: Set up and call a Copilot Studio agent
subtitle: Configure security, then use the four Direct Line requests to send and read messages.

steps.title: Configure agent security
steps.evidence: Publish the agent, select No Authentication in Security, copy the Web channel security secret, and activate Require secured access.

steps.title: Generate a Direct Line token
steps.evidence: Generate a Direct Line token, start a conversation, post a text message, and retrieve conversation activities with the token.
